headline: Chartwells and Home Grown Springfield presented school meal changes, new menus, and student programs; no votes were recorded.
summary: Chartwells, the district's food service partner since July 1, presented its school meal program. Topics included menu changes, local food purchasing, and student engagement events. No votes were taken.
discussion: Chartwells program presentation: Presenters described the meal program, its federal reimbursement of about $4.90 per meal, and its menu and staffing.
Halal and vegetarian meals: Members asked how halal meals are shown in the serving line. Staff described meal identifiers, daily options, and a separate menu.
Local food purchasing: Presenters said local purchasing is part of the contract, with a 1% increase each year, and named several local suppliers.
Navigate internship at Putnam: Presenters described a 12-week paid culinary pre-apprenticeship for students, with a boot camp first.
